text:
We first record the elementary order construction used throughout. Two
countable dense orders without endpoints, with the same finite list of dense
colors, are isomorphic by back-and-forth. This is the theorem of Skolem that
Vaught cites for \(T_n\) \cite[p.~319]{Vaught1961}; its uncolored case is
Cantor's theorem, which he cites for \(T_1\) \cite[p.~318]{Vaught1961}.
reason: Vaught 1961 justifies the one-model claim for T_1 by Cantor's theorem (p. 318) and the isomorphism of denumerable models of T_n, ignoring the constants, by Skolem's theorem [14] (p. 319). The annex back-and-forth proof is currently unattributed; this adds the source's attributions to the proof itself (the body text of n-a-004-01.tex now states them as well).
